summary: On the rooftop, Neo summons all his leg strength and launches himself into the air with a maniacal shriek, but he comes up drastically short and plummets past stories toward the ground. When he hits, the ground gives way and stretches like a trapeze net, bouncing him until he flips and comes to rest flat on his back. He laughs, unsure, wiping windblown tears from his face, and Morpheus exits the building and helps him up. Morpheus asks if Neo knows why he didn't make it; Neo guesses it's because he didn't think he would. Morpheus smiles and nods in confirmation.

what_changes.before: He does not understand why his jump fell short.
what_changes.after: He tentatively realizes his failure came from not believing he would make it.
what_changes.evidence: NEO / Because... I didn't think I would?

what_changes.before: He withholds whether Neo's explanation is correct.
what_changes.after: He confirms Neo's answer is right by smiling and nodding.

event_hint.one_line: Neo fails his first rooftop jump and learns from Morpheus that his disbelief was the cause.

uncertain: Whether Neo's stated reason is the complete explanation Morpheus intends, since Morpheus only nods without elaborating.
